correctness.rationale: The exact reduced 2(n+1)-state generator has leaf birth rate (c/sqrt(n))(1+y)(n-k), recovery rate k, second-hub infection (c/sqrt(n))k and recovery 1. Stationary first and second moment balances give EK_n<=2c sqrt(n) and EK_n²<=4c²n+2c sqrt(n), yielding tightness and uniform integrability of K_n/sqrt(n). Generator convergence gives the PDMP with du/dt=-u (Y=0), du/dt=1-u (Y=1), upward rate a(1+u), downward rate 1 where a=c². Stationary flux is zero and p1/p0=u/(1-u); solving the transport equation gives exact normalized densities. Strictly positive switching rates and compact invariant attracting strip give uniqueness, so all subsequences converge; UI transfers first moments. Independent differential identities and flux balance checked symbolically. Discrete finite-n numerics alone would not prove convergence.

General random-graph survival bounds do not dominate the exact stationary law.
